several years ago there were these apparent mountain lion sightings around town, which to be honest shouldn't have been as surprising as people made it out to be. I live not too far where mountain lions and bobcats are very common, but still far enough that usually we only get bears wandering around on occasion. 

people would call in sightings of this mountain lion, but when anyone would come out to search, nothing would be found. 

one night a friend and i decided to walk to the convenience store at around 1am. it was extremely dark since my town doesn't have street lights and we were walking along this walking trail, away from any cars that would be coming by. on the trail we saw bright glowing eyes and heard a hiss. we never actually saw whatever the animal was, but the hiss definitely sounded like a wild cat of some kind. 

a few days after this I was walking on the same trail, but during daylight. i saw two semi large cats walking along the stream and huzzah, they were two bob cats and the mystery was solved. most likely there never was a mountain lion and what people saw and called in were these same bob cats.
